---
name: Bug Report
about: Create a report to help fix a bug or wrong timetable data
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: dark-ous
---

**Describe the Bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Timetable Details**
- Campus: [e.g. Bibwewadi / Kondhwa]
- Branch: [e.g. CS / AI / AIDS]
- Division: [e.g. CS-H / AI-F]
- Batch: [e.g. B1 / B2 / B3]

**Expected Behavior**
What should have happened (e.g. correct room number, correct class time).

**Actual Behavior**
What actually happened.

**Device & Android Version**
- Device: [e.g. Samsung Galaxy S23, Pixel 7, Redmi Note 12]
- Android Version: [e.g. Android 13, Android 14]
